name: Jiangxi Firstar Panel Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Jiangxi Firstar Panel Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of precision molds and consumer electronic products in China. It offers window protection screens, touchscreens, LCD OLED display modules, fingerprint modules and touch pads, and precision structural components. The company provides solutions to consumer electronics, in-vehicle electronics, industrial controls, medical and smart home cover plates, and mold manufacturing. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Zhejiang Firstar Panel Technology Co., Ltd. Jiangxi Firstar Panel Technology Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2003 and is based in Taizhou, China.
